BiblicalUsage: Sar'aph is the word for the thoughts that crowd in on you, the anxious turnings of the mind. The psalmist knows them well: in the multitude of his thoughts within him God's comforts delight his soul, and he asks God to search him and know his thoughts.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that God does not flinch at the crowd of thoughts inside me; He meets them with comfort, and He knows them better than I do.
